exposure: personal growth one year after birth
outcome: perceived personal growth of mothers four years after childbirth
cohort: A group of 259 mothers participated in the study, completing self-report questionnaires one and four years following the birth of their child/ren (both full-term and pre-term).
finding: Personal growth after four years was higher among mothers of pre-term babies compared to full-term babies, increased over time, and was significantly predicted by being a mother to a pre-term baby, initial optimism, and personal growth one year after birth.
